Hi Quresh,

 

Not exactly citizen science, but we used data collected by managers over more than 40 years in an integrated population model with a Dail-Madsen model at its core, combined with a multistate capture-recapture model for survival and a Poisson regression for productivity.

 

Best regards,

José

Hi all. We are working on a data integration paper that combines professionally collected data with community science data to inform a Dail-Madsen style model (i.e., estimates population vital rates). Like everyone else, we want to claim our work is novel without necessarily implementing a rigorous and comprehensive literature review. We are unaware of anyone who has done this before, but I thought it might be worth leveraging the collective knowledge of folks on this list. Is anyone aware of any publications that describe such a study?
